top_sql.sql_sample: with selected_tasks as (               select CASE_PICK_TASK_ID,PICK_WAVE_ID from (                 select t.CASE_PICK_TASK_ID,t.PICK_WAVE_ID                   from RRL_CASE_PICK_TASK t                   join RRL_PICK_WAVE w on w.PICK_WAVE_ID=t.PICK_WAVE_ID                   join RRL_CUSTOMER_ORDER co on co.CUSTOMER_ORDER_ID=t.CUSTOMER_ORDER_ID                  where 1 = 1 and RRL_ACCESS_API.allowed(:view_actor,'case_pick_view','WAREHOUSE',to_char(t.WARE_ID),t.ASSIGNED_TO)=1 and t.STATUS not in ('READY_TO_SHIP', 'CANCELLED')                  order by t.STATUS,t.CREATED_AT,t.CASE_PICK_TASK_ID
